method: Actual PNG viewed in the independent child context; complete actual submitted sidecar prompt/history and batch source contracts compared with current source template/handlers and matching real baseline where available. No generation or product runtime tests.
selectedState: Owner trash mobile, three items: selected available note with rename; unselected folder; unavailable note. Idle unlocked, first page/no cursor.

functionalFindings.finding: Unavailable note is labelled暂不可读取 with disabled actions but omits the source mandatory explanation 原文件缺失、存在链接或暂时无法安全读取，请先检查服务器上的原文件。 This paragraph is always shown when !item.available and explains the locked state/next step.

fieldActionRoleStateChecks: Actual PNG/full prompt/current UI+restore/purge/API guards and actual390 trash baseline viewed. Count3/selected1/not-all-selected and file-only selection makes both batch actions valid; folder lacks purge, unavailable checkbox/actions disabled.
Valid renamed.md stays original directory/no overwrite and actual rename controls/help retained. Folder unknown time/size remains unknown; no fake successful restoration or total purge.
Unavailable item omits the actual always-rendered explanation/guidance paragraph. State/disabled controls remain visible but source-owned reason/help is missing.

styleFindings.finding: Raster texture/shading and approximate geometry remain illustrative. Use shared flat CSS tokens and source conditional scrolling/focus/disabled behavior; no exact CSS or responsive/runtime compliance claimed.

requiredCorrections: Add the exact source unavailable-item guidance paragraph under its metadata in both narrow views. Keep it unavailable and actions disabled, all existing counts/rename/folder rules/retention text unchanged; increase scroll height as needed. Do not invent a new retry/server-management action.
limitations: Static design review does not prove API execution, permissions, dirty/busy/close guards, focus/keyboard, persistence, canvas topology or responsive fit.
Only declared compatible state reviewed; hidden mutually exclusive branches remain separate mappings. Source-derived examples are not captured runtime results.
Per-image verdict does not complete full-design global consistency/coverage review or authorize product implementation.
